verdict.rationale: Bento's docs describe Workflows as visual "when this happens, do that" automations. Each starts with a trigger and runs steps with branching, delays and decisions. Workflows can be built from behavior, events and tags, and branches can be checked before they run. Events, API-posted events and form submissions all trigger automations, and workflows can fire outbound webhooks to external systems. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of automation behavior, evidence that agents can create or edit workflow rules programmatically (the MCP and CLI docs mention events, broadcasts and sequences but not workflows), and a documented list of trigger types; the plain-text AI builder claim is vague about what it actually builds.
